gold.user: User123 is a project manager who needs to redact sensitive information from project documents before sharing them with external stakeholders. They use this API to submit redaction requests for specific documents.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a request body containing the document ID and the specific information to be redacted, returning a confirmation of the request.

gold.user: User456 is a compliance officer who wants to track the status of redaction jobs submitted for various documents. They use this API to check if the redaction process is complete or still in progress.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current status of the redaction job, indicating whether it is pending, in progress, or completed, along with any relevant timestamps.
